LongCat-2.5-Preview.description: Meituan LongCat 2.5 Preview, the only model this pilot lists. The 1M-token context rests on the vendor's Retrieve Model sample for this model id, not on a normative sentence. This pilot declares text generate/stream only; tools, vision, structured output and thinking await separate evidence. Account access is unverified.

errorRules.message: Invalid or expired LongCat API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar} and the key in the LongCat platform console at {setupUrl}.

instructions: 1. Sign in to the LongCat API platform and create an API key.

2. LongCat-2.5-Preview is usage-priced pay-as-you-go. Promotional credits, if your account has any, are consumed first, but no free allowance is stated: do not assume free usage. The vendor's Pay-As-You-Go page says account verification is required before topping up, and its FAQ scopes that requirement to users in Mainland China (not tried on an account).
3. LongCat-2.0 is served on the same route but is outside this pilot's catalog scope, so it is not a default or a fallback here.
4. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} for this provider. The base URL is https://api.longcat.chat/openai/v1 and the chat route is POST /chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer authentication.
setup.description: LongCat (Meituan) text/stream pilot with a usage-priced LongCat-2.5-Preview default. No free allowance is stated; no account entitlement, roster, live inference or delivery is verified.

rosterVerified.method: Vendor API documentation facts supplied to this change: default model id, 1048576 context from the vendor's Retrieve Model sample plus the 1M prose, 131072 maximum output, base URL https://api.longcat.chat/openai/v1 and route POST /chat/completions with Bearer auth. No GET /models, credentials, account or inference ran; this legacy field does not assert roster verification.
